description: Source code implementing DER parsing functions for ASN.1 data types such as booleans, integers, time formats, and string types, used in cryptographic and network security contexts.

classes.name: BitString
classes.description: Represents a DER-encoded bit string with methods to assert bits and validate encoding.

classes.name: GeneralizedTime
classes.description: Represents a generalized time structure with comparison operators and validation methods.

methods.name: ParseBool
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from DER-encoded input.

methods.name: ParseBoolRelaxed
methods.description: Parses a boolean value with relaxed BER interpretation.

methods.name: IsValidInteger
methods.description: Checks if input is a valid ASN.1 integer and determines if it is negative.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a 64-bit unsigned integer from DER-encoded input.

methods.name: ParseUint8
methods.description: Parses an 8-bit unsigned integer from DER-encoded input.

methods.name: ParseUTCTime
methods.description: Parses a UTC time string into a GeneralizedTime object.

methods.name: ParseGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Parses a generalized time string into a GeneralizedTime object.

methods.name: ParseVisibleString
methods.description: Parses a VisibleString (printable ASCII) from input.

methods.name: ParseTeletexStringAsLatin1
methods.description: Converts a Teletex string to Latin-1 (ISO 8859-1) encoded UTF-8 string.
